description: DGM (Direction Generale de la Meteorologie, Morocco) weather alert bulletins covering the Jan-Feb 2026 Oued El Makhazine crisis window. Sourced from press citations of the bulletins, not the raw bulletin graphics themselves. Use as ground-truth to compare against what the pipeline (Agent 2) would have flagged and when.

bulletins.note: earliest precursor signal, ~8 days before releases began Jan 24

bulletins.level: red (Chefchaouen), orange (Al Hoceima/Larache and surrounding provinces)

bulletins.note: precursor bulletin ahead of the Feb 4 peak
explicitly labeled 'bulletin actualise' (updated bulletin) by press
press explicitly ties this to risque de crue majeure du Loukkos; quotes Larache council president Abdelmoumen Sebihi on inflows exceeding seuils habituels
coincides with the second fatal incident (flash flood, Tetouan, Feb 7-8)

usage_note: Do not cite DGM as the data source for the pipeline's own forecasts (Agent 2 uses independent open archives - GFS/ECMWF/ARPEGE via Open-Meteo). This file is for comparing the pipeline's flagged dates against DGM's real, independently-issued alert timeline in the evaluation section.
